svg.title: Kubernetes probe lifecycle comparison
svg.desc: Aligned application, probe, and lifecycle timelines. Hover over events for causes. Green means success or ready; red means failure or restart; amber means timeout or initialization.
svg.text: Deterministic virtual time · one Pod / one container · simplified fixed restart delay
✓ success × failure ! timeout dashed red: termination green traffic: ready pink traffic: ready but unable to serve
